next.pre_underwriting: review the risk and request the inspection if needed
next.market_submission: send the folder to the market
next.comparison: build the comparison from the confirmed proposals
next.insured_decision: present the comparison and await the insured's decision
next.proposal_issued: issue the proposal to the awarded insurer
next.ratified: await the insurer's ratification of terms
next.mirror_validation: validate the mirror policy against the proposal
next.endorsement_proposed: send the endorsement proposal to the insurer
next.endorsement_issued: attach the endorsement issued by the insurer
next.endorsement_applied: apply the endorsement deltas to the policy
next.collection_settled: settle the plan with every instalment paid
next.claim_reported: report the claim to the insurer
next.claim_adjusting: follow the adjustment with the loss adjuster
next.claim_settled: record the settlement and the payment
